analysisKind: independent post-download verification; original members unchanged
limitations: The workflow was cancelled while its producer still reported running; no whole-campaign success or final integrity guard is claimed.
Counts use each canonical completed condition/block directory once; duplicated working-result files and preparation passes are not independent launches.
Complete reports and per-process correctness were rechecked for completed paired blocks, including source cleanliness and identical viewport metadata.
This preservation summary derives no performance improvement from partial coverage and does not attribute cancellation to product behavior.
Repetitions within a process are correlated; cold means fresh application data, not a flushed OS file cache.
